title: 775. Global and Local Inversions

examples.explanation: One global and one local inversion coincide.

hints: Extra global inversions always span at least two positions, so compare each prefix maximum with later values.
Track the maximum of nums[0..i-2] while scanning i from 2 upward; if it ever exceeds nums[i], a non-local inversion exists.
Equivalently, an ideal permutation satisfies |nums[i] - i| <= 1 for every index.
